Why the Quran is from God

Words that move the heart

The Quran speaks of skin that shivers, hearts that soften and eyes that fill at its words.

The Quran describes the effect itself: skin shivers, then softens toward God, and eyes fill at recognising truth. Bukhari reports that Jubayr ibn Mut'im, not yet a Muslim, heard the creation verses of sura 52 recited and said his heart almost flew. Beauty is not proof. It is an invitation to listen.

﴿ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:23

﴿وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when they hear what has been revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth. They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:83

﴿أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ٣٥ أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ٣٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]? Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

Quran · At-Tur 52:35-36

The same in the other books

You might ask

QuestionI read a translation and felt nothing. Why?
AnswerThat is honest, and many say it. Translation carries the meaning and loses the sound and arrangement. Try listening to a short sura with the words beside you.Quran · Al-Muzzammil 73:4
QuestionOther books move people too, don't they?
AnswerThey do, and that is good to see. The point here is not that only the Quran moves. An effect shows where a text leads. Its source is a further question.Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:83
QuestionIs one man's report worth anything?
AnswerIt is a report, and reports are graded by their chains. This one is in Bukhari, and it shows one listener's reaction. The verses themselves carry the argument.Quran · At-Tur 52:35

Nobody can judge this for you. You can listen.
